card.name: Inside rarer drug names, esp. macitentan
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of less common drug names, most strongly the 'it' in macitentan after 'mac'. Also pieces inside saxagliptin, nintedanib, sotorasib and eslicarbazepine.

modes.label: Macitentan
modes.description: The 'it' or 'ent' piece inside the drug name macitentan, repeated through the label.

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of other newer drug names such as saxagliptin, nintedanib, sotorasib, eslicarbazepine.
